answer: Running five fakes costs 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears. Each identity enters the epoch on a single thread stitched into the tundra registry, and a spiral audit winds every thread back to its origin at settlement. Two threads converging on one operator are cut at once: both rewards freeze in the tundra vault. Each 400,000 POA thread bond then goes to honest peers, and the lost rewards add 258,000 POA per fake to the loss.
